gold_spent_100.title: First Purchase
gold_spent_100.description: Every captain starts with a first coin spent at the tavern or trader. Spend 100 gold to prove you invest in your own growth.
gold_spent_100.rewardDescription: Experience bundle for your first step into trade.

gold_spent_1000.title: Generous Merchant
gold_spent_1000.description: Your purse splashes often in port shops. Spend 1000 gold total and earn a reputation as a captain who does not count every coin.
gold_spent_1000.rewardDescription: A solid gold payout returns to your treasury.

gold_spent_10000.title: Tycoon
gold_spent_10000.description: Gold flows through your hands like ocean waves. Spend 10,000 total and join captains who shape the archipelago economy.
gold_spent_10000.rewardDescription: Sparkling diamonds - currency of true sea magnates.

gold_spent_5000.title: Merchant's Vault
gold_spent_5000.description: Traders along the coast know your name. Spend 5000 gold and show you fund expeditions without hesitation.
gold_spent_5000.rewardDescription: Gold and influence in port merchant circles.

level_2.title: First Level
level_2.description: Every legend begins with one step on the ladder of fame. Reach level 2 and feel your first real power surge.
level_2.rewardDescription: Experience to kick off your next adventure.

level_5.title: Seasoned Warrior
level_5.description: Five levels is no accident - it is a warrior path. The sea begins to take you seriously.

level_10.title: Master
level_10.description: Level ten opens elite locations and deadlier waters. You are a captain others listen to.

level_20.title: Veteran Captain
level_20.description: Two decades climbing the fame ladder made you recognizable in every port.
level_20.rewardDescription: Gold for long loyalty to the sea.

level_35.title: Level Veteran
level_35.description: Level 35 proves you survived storms, mutinies, and clashes with legends. Your crew respects you.
level_35.rewardDescription: Experience and gold - a veteran double reward.

level_50.title: Elite Captain
level_50.description: Level fifty puts you among pirate fleet admirals. Atlantis hears your footsteps.
level_50.rewardDescription: Massive XP and gold for an elite captain.

level_75.title: Sea Lord
level_75.description: Level seventy-five is rare even among legends. Your name is spoken with awe and fear.
level_75.rewardDescription: Huge experience worthy of a sea lord.

level_100.title: Ocean Ruler
level_100.description: One hundred levels - a boundary shanties sing about in every tavern. You became a living sea legend.
level_100.rewardDescription: Diamonds - crown of a true ocean ruler.

fight_won_1.title: First Victory
fight_won_1.description: Your first arena win is when a captain stops being a recruit. Blood, sweat, and triumph.

fight_won_10.title: Champion
fight_won_10.description: Ten wins build reputation. Opponents whisper your name before the clash.

fight_won_50.title: Unbeaten
fight_won_50.description: Fifty wins prove iron will. The arena trembles when you step in.
fight_won_50.rewardDescription: Random item - trophy of the unbeaten.

fight_veteran_100.title: Fight Veteran
fight_veteran_100.description: One hundred defeated opponents. Your moves are legend among port gladiators.
fight_veteran_100.rewardDescription: Random item from the arena veteran.

fight_veteran_250.title: Arena Veteran II
fight_veteran_250.description: Two hundred fifty wins - the arena is no longer a trial but your kingdom.
fight_veteran_250.rewardDescription: Gold and XP for arena dominance.

fight_veteran_500.title: Pirate Slayer
fight_veteran_500.description: Five hundred victories. Pirates avoid your ship like a curse. You are the slayer young sailors fear.
fight_veteran_500.rewardDescription: Rare or epic item - slayer loot.

fight_veteran_1000.title: Monster Slayer
fight_veteran_1000.description: One thousand wins. Even sea monsters yield to your determination.
fight_veteran_1000.rewardDescription: Legendary random item for the slayer.

fight_lost_1.title: First Defeat
fight_lost_1.description: Falling on arena sand teaches humility. Every great captain knows defeat.

fight_lost_10.title: Learning Through Defeat
fight_lost_10.description: Ten losses are ten lessons. You analyze mistakes and return stronger.

fight_lost_50.title: Perseverance
fight_lost_50.description: Fifty losses did not break your spirit. That makes you dangerous.

collector_10.title: First 10 Items Collected
collector_10.description: Every treasure tells a story. Collect ten unique items and begin your collection.

collector_25.title: Collector II
collector_25.description: Twenty-five items in your chest - the passion of a true treasure hunter shows.

collector_50.title: Collector III
collector_50.description: Fifty unique trophies. Your chest looks like a pirate relic museum.
collector_50.rewardDescription: Gold and XP for Collector III.

collector_75.title: Collector IV
collector_75.description: Seventy-five items - a collection worthy of an admiral. Few match your passion.
collector_75.rewardDescription: Gold and XP for a master collection.

collector_100.title: Collector V
collector_100.description: One hundred items in your registry. Every port wants to see your treasure chest.
collector_100.rewardDescription: Gold and XP for Collector V.

collector_150.title: Master Collector
collector_150.description: One hundred fifty unique trophies - a boundary only archipelago legends cross.
collector_150.rewardDescription: Gold and diamonds for a master collection.

rare_item_1.title: First Rare Item
rare_item_1.description: Your first rare item shines differently in lantern light. The start of elite gear.
rare_item_1.rewardDescription: Experience for your first rare loot.

epic_collector_10.title: Epic Treasure Hunter
epic_collector_10.description: Ten epic items - each carries echoes of sea legends and cursed battles.

legendary_collector_5.title: Legend Seeker
legendary_collector_5.description: Five legendary items. The sea yields its most precious secrets.

legendary_collector_10.title: Legend Hunter I
legendary_collector_10.description: Ten legendary trophies - your chest glows like Atlantis treasure.

legendary_collector_15.title: Legend Hunter II
legendary_collector_15.description: Fifteen legendary items. You are the collector whispered about in every cove.

equipment_full.title: First Full Equipment
equipment_full.description: Every slot filled - for the first time you feel ready for real challenges.

rare_equipment_full.title: Full Rare Set
rare_equipment_full.description: All gear at rare quality - your silhouette scares foes before the fight.
rare_equipment_full.rewardDescription: Diamonds for a full rare set.

epic_equipment_full.title: Full Epic Set
epic_equipment_full.description: Epic glow on every gear piece. You look like an avatar of the sea storm.
epic_equipment_full.rewardDescription: Experience for a full epic set.

legendary_equipment_full.title: Full Legendary Set
legendary_equipment_full.description: Legendary gear head to toe - Poseidon watches with interest.
legendary_equipment_full.rewardDescription: Diamonds for a legendary full set.

all_dungeons.title: Dungeon Master
all_dungeons.description: All dungeons cleared. Every chamber, boss, and curse - behind you.
all_dungeons.rewardDescription: Massive XP for the dungeon master.

dungeon_krypta.title: Complete the Crypt
dungeon_krypta.description: Pass through the Crypt misty corridors and face undead admirals.

dungeon_kraken.title: Complete the Kraken
dungeon_kraken.description: Reach the sea monster heart and survive waves that swallowed hundreds of ships.

dungeon_forteca.title: Complete Blackbeard Fortress
dungeon_forteca.description: Conquer the most famous corsair fortress. Every wall tells of blood and gold.

dungeon_wulkan.title: Complete Davy Jones Volcano
dungeon_wulkan.description: Cross volcanic depths where drowned souls await their fate.

dungeon_palac.title: Complete Poseidon's Palace
dungeon_palac.description: Reach the throne at Atlantis heart. The water itself yields to your will.

dungeon_all_bosses.title: Dungeon Boss Slayer
dungeon_all_bosses.description: Every dungeon boss lies defeated. From the Lich Admiral to Poseidon Avatar.
dungeon_all_bosses.rewardDescription: Random item for the boss slayer.

bestiary_complete.title: Great Bestiary Explorer
bestiary_complete.description: Discover every bestiary entry. Every creature, every legend - documented.

dungeon_titles_all.title: Dungeon Title Collector
dungeon_titles_all.description: Unlock all five dungeon completion titles. Your trophy wall is complete.

sea_legend.title: Sea Legend
sea_legend.description: All dungeons done and level 50 reached. The seas sing your name.
sea_legend.rewardDescription: Diamonds - mark of a true sea legend.

collector_200.title: Collector VI
collector_200.description: Two hundred unique trophies in your registry. Every port dreams of such a treasure chest.
collector_200.rewardDescription: Gold and XP for Collector VI.

collector_250.title: Collector VII
collector_250.description: Two hundred fifty items - a boundary only grand master collectors cross.
collector_250.rewardDescription: Gold and XP for Collector VII.

collector_300.title: Collector VIII
collector_300.description: Three hundred unique relics. Your collection rivals the vaults of admirals and lords of Atlantis.
collector_300.rewardDescription: Gold and diamonds for Collector VIII.

epic_collector_25.title: Epic Relic Grandmaster
epic_collector_25.description: Twenty-five epic items - each carries echoes of sea battles and cursed legends.
epic_collector_25.rewardDescription: Experience and gold for hunting epic treasures.

legendary_collector_20.title: Legend Hunter III
legendary_collector_20.description: Twenty legendary trophies. The sea begins to treat you as a living keeper of its secrets.

legendary_collector_25.title: Legend Hunter IV
legendary_collector_25.description: Twenty-five legendary items. Your chest glows like an Atlantis vault.

legendary_collector_30.title: Legend Hunter V
legendary_collector_30.description: Thirty legendary relics - a boundary whispered in every cove of the archipelago.

level_125.title: Legend Captain
level_125.description: Level 125 - your name sounds like a shanty in taverns across three continents.
level_125.rewardDescription: Experience and gold for the legend climb.

level_150.title: Wave Ruler
level_150.description: Level one hundred fifty - the waves themselves yield to your will.
level_150.rewardDescription: Experience and diamonds for the wave ruler.

level_175.title: Depths Guardian
level_175.description: Level 175 proves you survived the abyss and returned with it in your eyes.
level_175.rewardDescription: Experience and gold for the depths guardian.

level_200.title: Immortal Captain
level_200.description: Level two hundred - a boundary even the ghosts of admirals sing about.

fight_veteran_2000.title: Fight Veteran III
fight_veteran_2000.description: Two thousand wins. The arena is no longer a trial - it is your home.
fight_veteran_2000.rewardDescription: Gold and XP for the arena veteran.

fight_veteran_5000.title: Fight Veteran IV
fight_veteran_5000.description: Five thousand victories. Opponents avoid your shadow like a curse.
fight_veteran_5000.rewardDescription: Random item and diamonds for the slayer.

gold_spent_25000.title: Port Magnate
gold_spent_25000.description: Twenty-five thousand gold spent - the archipelago economy bears your mark.

titles_all_unlocked.title: Lord of Titles
titles_all_unlocked.description: Unlock every title in the game. Your trophy wall is complete.
titles_all_unlocked.rewardDescription: Diamonds for the complete title set.

fight_quests_complete.title: Arena Master
fight_quests_complete.description: Complete every fight-category quest - from first victory to thousands of triumphs.
fight_quests_complete.rewardDescription: Massive XP for the arena master.

collector_350.title: Collector IX
collector_350.description: Three hundred fifty unique trophies - your chest rivals the vaults of Atlantis emperors.
collector_350.rewardDescription: Gold and XP for Collector IX.

collector_400.title: Collector X
collector_400.description: Four hundred items. The archipelago knows you as a living treasure catalog.
collector_400.rewardDescription: Gold and diamonds for Collector X.

collector_500.title: Collector XII
collector_500.description: Five hundred unique relics - a boundary shanties sing about in every tavern.
collector_500.rewardDescription: Gold and diamonds for Collector XII.

epic_collector_50.title: Epic Hunter III
epic_collector_50.description: Fifty epic items - each carries echoes of storms and cursed battles.
epic_collector_50.rewardDescription: Experience and gold for Epic Hunter III.

epic_collector_75.title: Epic Hunter IV
epic_collector_75.description: Seventy-five epic relics. Your chest glows like an Atlantis lighthouse.
epic_collector_75.rewardDescription: Experience and diamonds for Epic Hunter IV.

epic_collector_100.title: Epic Hunter V
epic_collector_100.description: One hundred epic items - mastery even admirals envy.

legendary_collector_40.title: Legend Hunter VI
legendary_collector_40.description: Forty legendary trophies. The sea yields its oldest secrets.

legendary_collector_50.title: Legend Hunter VII
legendary_collector_50.description: Fifty legends in your chest - leviathans whisper your name in fear.

legendary_collector_75.title: Legend Hunter VIII
legendary_collector_75.description: Seventy-five legendary relics - you rule treasures kings only dream of.

fight_veteran_7500.title: Fight Veteran V
fight_veteran_7500.description: Seven thousand five hundred wins. The arena trembles at your footsteps.
fight_veteran_7500.rewardDescription: Gold and XP for Fight Veteran V.

fight_veteran_10000.title: Fight Veteran VI
fight_veteran_10000.description: Ten thousand victories - fight archmastery recognized across every sea.

fight_veteran_15000.title: Fight Veteran VII
fight_veteran_15000.description: Fifteen thousand triumphs. Oceans part before your blade.

level_225.title: Unbeaten Corsair
level_225.description: Level 225 - corsair kings salute your flag.
level_225.rewardDescription: Experience and gold for the unbeaten corsair.

level_250.title: Emperor of Atlantis
level_250.description: Level 250 - the drowned throne of Atlantis recognizes its heir.
level_250.rewardDescription: Experience and diamonds for the emperor.

level_300.title: Eternal Captain
level_300.description: Level 300 - even time cannot retire your command.

gold_spent_50000.title: Merchant King
gold_spent_50000.description: Fifty thousand gold spent - archipelago trade revolves around you.

gold_spent_100000.title: Treasury Lord
gold_spent_100000.description: One hundred thousand gold has flowed through your hands like the tide.

collector_quests_complete.title: Collection Master
collector_quests_complete.description: Complete every collector quest - from the first ten to five hundred trophies.

level_quests_complete.title: Level Master
level_quests_complete.description: Complete every level-series quest - from the first step to eternal command.

epic_quests_complete.title: Lord of Epic Relics
epic_quests_complete.description: Complete every epic-item quest and become lord of epic treasures.
epic_quests_complete.rewardDescription: Massive XP for the lord of epic relics.
